$note.emberSigil.block: Ember Sigil — the Block it gives at the start of each fight, while it sits in a slot of an equipped armament.
$note.thornSigil.bleed: Thorn Sigil — the Bleed your first attack hit of each fight applies, while it sits in a slot of an equipped armament.
$note.tideSigil.n: Tide Sigil — every this-many-th card you play in a fight draws, while it sits in a slot of an equipped armament.
$note.tideSigil.draw: Tide Sigil — how many cards that card draws.
$note.hearthSigil.block: Hearth Sigil — the Block you gain whenever you heal, while it sits in a slot of an equipped armament.
$note.vigilSigil.pct: Sigil of the Last Vigil — the HP percent at or below which it raises its guard at the start of a fight, while attuned.
$note.vigilSigil.block: Sigil of the Last Vigil — the Block it gives at the start of a fight you enter at or below its HP percent, while attuned.
$note.pyreSigil.block: Pyre Sigil — the Block you gain whenever a card is exhausted, while attuned.
$note.gravelightSigil.pct: Gravelight Sigil — the HP percent at or below which a fallen enemy heals you, while attuned.
$note.gravelightSigil.heal: Gravelight Sigil — the HP an enemy's death heals while you are at or below its HP percent, while attuned.
$note.attuneMax: How many legendary sigils a run can hold attuned at once, chosen in the Armoury out of combat. 0 means none can be attuned.
$note.dropChancePct.normal: The chance, 0 to 100, that a won normal fight drops a legendary sigil the run does not own. 0 never drops and draws nothing.
$note.dropChancePct.elite: The chance, 0 to 100, that a won elite fight drops a legendary sigil the run does not own. 0 never drops and draws nothing.
$note.dropChancePct.boss: The chance, 0 to 100, that a boss whose reward menu opens drops a legendary sigil the run does not own. The last boss of a run ends it and drops none. 0 never drops and draws nothing.
$note.dropChancePct.treasure: The chance, 0 to 100, that a treasure room drops a legendary sigil the run does not own. 0 never drops and draws nothing.
